name: Lend sUSDe and USDe on Aave (looping required)
description: This campaign is part of Ethena’s Liquid Leverage program, with Merkl acting as the distribution partner in collaboration with the ACI. The campaign considers the lowest amount of tokens lent across the sUSDe and USDe markets. It will run indefinitely, with the stated rate expected to remain roughly in line with the sUSDe rate for the foreseeable future. To be eligible, users must also borrow USDC, USDT, or USDS and maintain a health factor below 2.5.
